01 / The context

A problem worth exploring.

GTM and sales teams need to connect LinkedIn engagement to account context and useful next actions.

An attribution prototype that helps go-to-market and sales teams interpret engagement with LinkedIn posts and prioritize follow-up actions. Built with Codex.

03 / Decisions & evidence

Behind the experience.

Approach & boundaries

The repository documents ingestion, enrichment, scoring, account mapping, and next-best actions. The portfolio lists React + Vite, Python, LinkedIn, Exa, and OpenAI APIs. Engagement signals support prioritization; they do not prove causation. The public README identifies PostgreSQL storage and mock/CSV ingestion alongside an API scaffold; it does not establish a production LinkedIn integration.
